```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SETUP: fetch, clean, merge (runs once, feeds every page below)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import wbgapi as wb
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

START_YEAR = 2000
END_YEAR = 2024

INDICATORS = {
    "physicians_per_1000":     "SH.MED.PHYS.ZS",
    "death_reg_completeness":  "SP.REG.DTHS.ZS",
    "uhc_infectious_subindex": "SH.UHC.SCI.ID",
    "spi_pillar5":             "IQ.SPI.PIL5",
    "tb_detection_rate":       "SH.TBS.DTEC.ZS",
}
CAPACITY_VARS = ["physicians_per_1000", "death_reg_completeness",
                  "uhc_infectious_subindex", "spi_pillar5"]
OUTCOME_VAR = "tb_detection_rate"

def fetch_indicator(code: str, name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = wb.data.DataFrame(
        code, time=range(START_YEAR, END_YEAR + 1),
        labels=True, numericTimeKeys=True, skipBlanks=False,
    )
    df = df.reset_index().rename(columns={"economy": "country_code", "Country": "country_name"})
    id_vars = [c for c in ["country_code", "country_name"] if c in df.columns]
    long_df = df.melt(id_vars=id_vars, var_name="year", value_name=name)
    long_df["year"] = long_df["year"].astype(int)
    return long_df

frames = [fetch_indicator(code, name) for name, code in INDICATORS.items()]

merged = frames[0]
for f in frames[1:]:
    merged = merged.merge(
        f.drop(columns=[c for c in f.columns if c == "country_name"]),
        on=["country_code", "year"], how="outer",
    )
name_lookup = frames[0][["country_code", "country_name"]].drop_duplicates()
merged = merged.drop(columns=["country_name"], errors="ignore").merge(name_lookup, on="country_code", how="left")

# Drop region/income aggregates -- keep only real countries
econ_meta = pd.DataFrame(wb.economy.list())
real_country_codes = econ_meta.loc[~econ_meta["aggregate"], "id"].tolist()
region_lookup = econ_meta.loc[~econ_meta["aggregate"], ["id", "region"]].rename(
    columns={"id": "country_code", "region": "region_code"}
)
merged = merged[merged["country_code"].isin(real_country_codes)]
merged = merged.merge(region_lookup, on="country_code", how="left")

# Detect actual coverage per indicator -- don't assume a shared range
coverage = {}
for var in INDICATORS:
    non_null = merged.loc[merged[var].notna(), "year"]
    if len(non_null):
        coverage[var] = (non_null.min(), non_null.max())

common_start = max(v[0] for v in coverage.values())
common_end = min(v[1] for v in coverage.values())

panel_full = merged.copy()
panel_common = merged[(merged["year"] >= common_start) & (merged["year"] <= common_end)].copy()
panel_common["n_missing"] = panel_common[list(INDICATORS)].isna().sum(axis=1)
panel_common = panel_common[panel_common["n_missing"] <= 2].drop(columns="n_missing")

# Composite surveillance capacity index (z-score average of the 4 capacity vars)
for var in CAPACITY_VARS:
    panel_common[f"{var}_z"] = (panel_common[var] - panel_common[var].mean()) / panel_common[var].std()
panel_common["surveillance_capacity_index"] = panel_common[[f"{v}_z" for v in CAPACITY_VARS]].mean(axis=1, skipna=True)

latest_year = panel_common["year"].max()
latest = panel_common[panel_common["year"] == latest_year].dropna(
    subset=["surveillance_capacity_index", OUTCOME_VAR]
)
corr_value = latest["surveillance_capacity_index"].corr(latest[OUTCOME_VAR])
n_countries = latest["country_code"].nunique()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Surveillance Capacity vs. TB Detection Rate (latest common year)"
fig1 = px.scatter(
    latest, x="surveillance_capacity_index", y=OUTCOME_VAR,
    color="region_code", hover_name="country_name",
    trendline="ols", trendline_scope="overall",
    labels={
        "surveillance_capacity_index": "Surveillance capacity index (z-score composite)",
        OUTCOME_VAR: "TB detection rate, all forms (%)",
        "region_code": "Region",
    },
)
fig1.update_layout(legend_title_text="Region")
fig1
```

# Regional Comparison

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Average Surveillance Capacity Index by Region"
region_avg = (
    latest.groupby("region_code")["surveillance_capacity_index"]
    .mean().sort_values().reset_index()
)
fig2 = px.bar(
    region_avg, x="surveillance_capacity_index", y="region_code", orientation="h",
    labels={"surveillance_capacity_index": "Capacity index (z-score)", "region_code": "Region"},
    color="surveillance_capacity_index", color_continuous_scale="Blues",
)
fig2.update_layout(coloraxis_showscale=False)
fig2
```

```{python}
#| title: "TB Detection Rate by Region"
region_tb = latest.groupby("region_code")[OUTCOME_VAR].mean().sort_values().reset_index()
fig3 = px.bar(
    region_tb, x=OUTCOME_VAR, y="region_code", orientation="h",
    labels={OUTCOME_VAR: "TB detection rate (%)", "region_code": "Region"},
    color=OUTCOME_VAR, color_continuous_scale="Oranges",
)
fig3.update_layout(coloraxis_showscale=False)
fig3
```

```{python}
fig4
```

```{python}
#| title: "Regional SPI Pillar 5 (Data Infrastructure) Trend"

)
```
